paper: Component 1: Greece and Persia (J198/01) — Section B
title: Hub GCSE Ancient History Topic Checklist (Aligned to Cambridge OCR J198)
subtitle: J198/01 Section B: From Tyranny to Democracy, 546–483 BC
disclaimer: Aligned to Cambridge OCR GCSE (9–1) Ancient History (J198). Independent educational resource by The History Revision Hub; not endorsed by Cambridge OCR.

topics.title: Peisistratids and Fall of Hippias
points: The concept of tyranny; the Peisistratids, their actions and characteristics of their rule; Harmodios and Aristogeiton's involvement in the assassination of Hipparchus; the fall of Hippias

topics.title: Polycrates, Maeandrius and Syloson
points: Accession of Polycrates; building and engineering achievements of Polycrates; failed succession of Maeandrius; support for the accession of Syloson

sections.title: The Emergence of Democracy in Athens

topics.title: Cleisthenes' Reforms and Spartan Opposition
points: Cleisthenes and his rivalry with Isagoras; the introduction of isegoria by Cleisthenes; restructuring of tribes, demes and phratries, and the reorganisation of the boule

topics.title: Strategoi, Marathon and Ostracism
points: Establishment of the ten strategoi; the Battle of Marathon and its significance for democracy; onset and uses of ostracism; the role and treatment of Miltiades, Themistocles and Aristides
